cases.name: core-only idle mount and bounded native results expose a computed combobox/grid/link hierarchy
prefix/text modes and Unicode keep literal native membership and exact handoff query meaning
virtual arrows clamp, preserve raw input/focus and use stable current cell IDs without automatic selection
native editing and modifier combinations clear virtual selection without replacing text or activating links
Enter without a virtual selection searches; Enter on the current result follows its actual anchor
result anchors retain actual modified/new-tab and context-menu behavior
Escape preserves the field; Tab leaves normally and the separate full-results link remains reachable
composition suppresses interim submit/navigation and performs one committed native search
early arrows share pending work and retain only explicit first/last navigation intent
input edits, revision replacements and late ignored-abort replies cannot retain or revive stale active IDs
outside pointer and focus changes cancel pending programmatic presentation even when focus was already outside
native failures, malformed results, no-results and Clear retain deliberate recoverable feedback
public single-line refusal leaves earlier input intact; malformed/oversized values stay visible with no handoff
options are captured before DOM mutation and root ownership stays exclusive across UI presets
pending destruction restores exact authored Nodes and never disposes or revives its borrowed owner
authored fallback callbacks and abort-triggered replacements cannot erase newer mounts
native popover cancellation/closure and queued old toggles keep expansion and active references truthful
one popup per document uses independent state and a shared borrowed engine without disposing it
optional shortcut coordinates with modal, ignores native editing contexts and removes its owned listener
owned open/closed shadow focus stays inside; ancestor native dialog Escape dismisses only the dropdown first
real module-worker hits remain native and actual worker loss is visible without fallback
top-layer placement survives clipping/transform, viewport edges and active-cell scrolling with finite rendered growth
long RTL/dark/text-scaled and forced-color layouts retain controls, active indication and selected axe rules
a short viewport with no usable row retains truthful totals and an accessible full-results recovery without auto-reopening

nativeWebKitBaseline.method: Plain native fields/button/anchors and manual popover; no Raveldex code or setting change

visualReview.method: Viewed saved final screenshots; supporting visual review only
visualReview.findings: Visible popup/control separation, bounded popup, active/focus indicators, and truthful no-space recovery agree with browser assertions in these saved states. No human AT/physical-device/actual browser zoom claim.

limitations: Human AT/speech: Not run. Chrome/Chromium CDP native AX and page DOM/ARIA snapshots are separate supporting evidence.

WebKit is Playwright WebKit 26.5, not native Safari. Plain Tab dismissal is tested; native Option/Alt+Tab is used for ordinary button/link traversal after a no-Raveldex baseline proved the recorded preference.

Modified new-tab proof in recorded WebKit: Blocked, equally for native baseline and component. Middle click follows the native baseline same-page destination; no synthetic navigation or settings change.
Physical IME/touch/mobile keyboard/actual browser zoom: Not run. Synthetic composition and 200% root-font text scaling are labeled.
Memory/physical paint/latency: Not measured. Graph byte, serialized byte and DOM quantities only.

defectsFixedByRuntimeOwner: Pending-arrow intent reset before native reply publication.
Synchronous native popover hide ARIA/active-state gap.
Clear lost focus when hiding focused Retry/full-results or owned popup link.
Suppressed composition left interim handoff URL after commit.
Explicit open/shortcut could not reveal an offscreen input.
harnessClassifications: Native Home/End compared against matched ordinary input in a non-scrolling document, with document.hasFocus recorded; native editing was not overridden.
An oversized active cell cannot fit wholly inside a 128px scrollport; assert at least a usable 44px visible active portion and record full geometry.
Shadow hosts must be visibly situated and styles loaded before opening; offscreen refusal remains correct.
Long 200% label can consume the short viewport; verify truthful no-space recovery separately from the actual dark RTL popup.
WebKit native pointer Clear focus is recorded in capture phase; preserve the actual native owner rather than assuming every platform focuses a clicked button.
Modified new-page proof waits the actual target URL, preserving real link activation.
